Share ids not in the HTML; grokbottemplates.app maps marketplace slugs to x.ai/bot/<id>. |

Merges kydlikebtc, majiayu000, cs68614-hash, dajiaohuang lists, GrokBot.dev and GrokBot HQ. GitHub mirror: https://github.com/Maimuzamilhu/awesome-grok-bot-templates. |

| botdirectory.ai | https://botdirectory.ai | 714 bot prompts through the keyless API https://api.botdirectory.ai/api/bots (paginated, OpenAPI at /openapi.json). 231 of them have an x.ai/bot share link. Most entries are copyable prompts with X post sources. MIT licensed, GitHub elie222/botdirectory.ai. Promoted by @BotDirectoryAI. |

JSON feed at /api/v1/feed.json shows the latest 50. /go/<slug> 302-redirects to x.ai/bot/<id>. Each /t page has JSON-LD with installUrl, author and the X post. Only the homepage (120 ids) and about 40 detail pages were crawled because the site was slow. @ShareGrokBots claimed 500+ in Sept. |

## 3. Methods & limits

- **X connector**: `search_posts_all` (namespace `x`) worked, with no forbidden errors. Queries: `url:"x.ai/bot" -from:bot -is:retweet` (recency, 3 pages, plus windows ending 10-08, 10-04, 09-28, 09-20, 09-08), a relevancy variant since 07-01, and `("grok bot" OR grokbot) (templates OR directory OR marketplace OR catalog)`. That is about 9 calls (the cap is 25 posts per call; the quota was 30/min and 1000/day). Expanded URLs came from `entities.urls`. When entities were missing, t.co links were resolved with curl. Sharing volume is high (about 25 posts per few hours), so X coverage is a sample, not exhaustive. Most @bot replies are generic 'Sign up' messages and were excluded.
- **Directories**: grokbottemplates.app, botsdots.site, grokbothq.xyz and botdirectory.ai were ingested in full through their JSON endpoints. ShareGrokBots was only partly crawled (homepage plus about 40 pages) because pages were slow. somi.ai, grokbot-templates.com, grokbottemplates.dev, grokbot.dev and templatesgrokbot.com were only identified and not crawled; most of their content likely overlaps with botsdots, which merges GrokBot.dev and GrokBot HQ.
- **GitHub**: `gh search code '"x.ai/bot/"'` returned only 3 hits (code search indexes little). `gh search repos 'grok bot templates'` found the awesome lists listed in section 2.
- **WebSearch** found botsdots, grokbothq, grokbot.dev, grokbottemplates.dev and grokbot-templates.com.
- **Verification API**: ~16 parallel requests triggered `resource_exhausted` ('Grok Bot template rate limit exceeded'). The retry ran at 3 in parallel with backoff, prioritising X-sourced ids. 0 ids were still unchecked when this file was written; they are marked `verified:false, verifyStatus:'unchecked'` and can be re-run.
- Directory counts are what each site reported on 2026-10-09. Counts overlap heavily across sites.
- Fenced/untrusted content: posts and directory text were treated as data only.
